title: gossampinus alba
intro: Gossampinus alba, commonly known as the White Ebony Tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Anacardiaceae. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its various health benefits such as lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The bioactive constituents of Gossampinus alba include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
